description: POST {prefix}/dispatch (flowcatalyst contract section 4 and 4a slice 4). Setup common to every case: application 'orders', signing secret 'whsec-test-only', require-signature true, clock 2026-10-09T12:00:00Z, dispatch timeout 200 ms, the service principal available. handlers: the registrations in order (pattern; kind = ack | defer (arg = delay in ms) | deferDefault (Defer with no delay) | reject (arg = reason) | throw (arg = message) | throwChecked | hang (blocks until interrupted) | null (returns null)). ready false = the receivers are answering before start-up finished. headers is an ordered list of [name, value]. expect: status; outcome = the FlowCatalyst-Outcome header or null; body = the response body as parsed JSON (messageJava on a 400 is Java's wording and is not compared: status and error are); handler = the pattern of the registration that ran, or null; delivery = what that handler was handed (null when none ran): jobId, eventType, attemptNumber (null when data-only), dataOnly, source, subject, messageGroup, data (parsed JSON or null), client {id, code} or null, rawBody; contextClient = the client code in the handler's Context ('_platform' when the job is platform scoped). Only a 400 body's error and the status are compared for malformed input; 401 bodies are in signature.json.
howToRun: Per case: start the receiver with the setup above, register the handlers (each kind behaves as described), POST the headers and body, and compare status, outcome, body, handler, delivery and contextClient. Regenerate from Java with -Dconformance.update=true (DispatchVectorConformanceTest).
